title: Cinematic Stills
description: Cinematic Stills is an ongoing collection of small-format paintings inspired by photographic archives, intense flash aesthetic, and the raw intimacy of close-up film frames. Operating at the intersection of photographic memory and cinematic narrative, each intimate canvas isolates a tightly cropped moment - freezing a fleeting scene as if paused mid-film. Defined by harsh flash-like illumination, deep dramatic shadows, and high contrast, the artworks transform everyday visual fragments into enigmatic story stills.
